quality_policy.note: The gates enforce a JCR Q1-targeting readiness floor; no software can guarantee novelty, peer-review acceptance or doctoral admission.

intake.author_task: Capture only user-confirmed goals, constraints, budget, compute, schedule, application routes, exclusions and ethical boundaries. Leave unknown material facts explicit. Do not approve or advance the gate.

topic-intelligence.hard_floor: Every scored dimension >= 8.0; overall >= 8.5; at least 5 closest primary works; at least 3 traceable databases, adjacent fields and query families; explicit counterevidence, originality residual risk, doctoral synthesis and reliability strategy; at least two current JCR Q1 SCI/SCIE candidate venues.
topic-intelligence.author_task: Research at least three serious topic candidates using current primary sources, adjacent literatures, patents where applicable, and market/position evidence where relevant. Write schema-bound evidence/search-log.jsonl and program/originality-audit.json so every claimed database, query family and closest work is traceable. Preserve closest-work comparisons, counterevidence, non-novel elements, rejection reasons and uncertainty, and make the core thesis A plus independent extension B form a defensible doctoral knowledge contribution. Do not claim novelty from absence alone.

paper-architecture.hard_floor: Every paper must have a unique falsifiable claim, independently sufficient primary evidence, standalone scientific value, a structured originality boundary, at least two current JCR Q1 venues, and a high-level experiment strategy; every paper pair must pass the anti-salami distinctness matrix; the portfolio must synthesize into one doctoral contribution.
paper-architecture.author_task: Build program/paper-map.json schema 2.0 and a paper-contract schema 2.0 for every configured paper. Compare every paper pair, require different research questions and primary claims, independently sufficient evidence and standalone value, explain any shared primary outcome, state shared assets and merge triggers, and show cumulative doctoral progression. Write structured research artifacts in English and reject salami slicing.

experiment-design.hard_floor: Every paper needs one or more linked experiment designs with traceable strong-recent, domain-standard and simple baselines; fair tuning/evaluation; ablations; leakage controls; primary metrics; estimands, practical thresholds, effect sizes and intervals; multiplicity; power/precision; >=3 seeds for stochastic work; robustness, negative controls, external validity, stopping and falsification rules; every planned run must belong to exactly one design.
experiment-design.author_task: Produce licensed dataset manifests, one or more schema-bound experiment designs per paper, a machine-executable global plan and a hard budget. Pre-register confirmatory hypotheses, estimands, practical significance, units of analysis, splits, preprocessing fit scope, traceable baseline sources and versions, comparable tuning budgets, ablations, primary and secondary metrics, uncertainty, statistical tests/models, effect sizes, confidence intervals, multiplicity, power or precision, seeds, external validation, negative controls, robustness, stopping rules and negative-result handling. Never confirm a license for the human.

experiment-execution.hard_floor: Every scored dimension >= 8.0; overall >= 8.5; observed evidence must support calibrated claims, robustness, external validity, statistics and reproducibility expected by a strong JCR Q1 review. Failed and negative runs remain visible.
experiment-execution.author_task: Execute only the exact G3-approved plan through scripts/experiment_runner.py. Preserve failed attempts, immutable configuration, output hashes and negative results. Build the claim-evidence matrix and reproducibility report without selecting favorable runs.

writing-and-review.hard_floor: Every scored dimension >= 8.0; overall >= 8.5; selected venue must be current JCR Q1 SCI/SCIE with IF >1.0; manuscript body must pass deterministic English-language validation; two adversarial review rounds have no unresolved fatal findings.
writing-and-review.author_task: Work only on state.active_paper. Write the complete manuscript body, abstract, captions, tables, supplement, responses and cover material in English from the claim-evidence matrix; run deterministic English-language, citation and venue compliance checks; preserve two review rounds and itemized responses; complete disclosures. Never invent citations, results, authorship or venue status, and never submit.
